measurement_note: Size M is max(tx, ty). Starting at (1, 1), each tier alternately increases the two coordinates along a reachable Fibonacci-like route of 6, 10, or 14 moves. The targets 21, 144, and 987 span 47x. Reverse reconstruction takes O(log M) steps, while a correct forward breadth-first search explores the rapidly growing set of reachable points at smaller depths and must fail only the scaling verdict.
